summary: Outputs extra information channels from any referenced operator, including family-specific info, general info, optional timecode, and filtered values.
key_concepts: Outputs information channels for the operator referenced by the Operator path.
Info Type can output all channels, general/operator-family channels, or optional timecode channels when the target has a .timecode member.
Scope filters info channel names with patterns, while Values and Range filter channels by numeric value.
Passive off forces the target operator to cook before query; Passive on avoids the forced cook and can be a frame late.
Children Cook Time adds a component child cook-time total channel but can cost more on large networks.

key_params.name: infotype
key_params.note: All, general, timecode, or OP-specific channel set

key_params.name: values
key_params.note: Select all, inside range, or outside range

key_params.name: range
key_params.note: Range bounds used by value filtering

key_params.name: passive
key_params.note: Avoid forcing the target operator to cook before querying

key_params.name: childcooktime
key_params.note: Include child cook-time total for components

common_gotchas: When Passive is off, Info CHOP can force the target OP to cook.
When Passive is on, data can be one frame late if target and Info cook in the same frame.
Timecode info only appears for operators with a .timecode member.
Info CHOP channels are also often exposed as Python members on the target operator class.
Use Info CHOP for diagnostics and monitoring, not as a substitute for stable semantic outputs when those exist.
